scope: Evidence-driven target selection only. No CUDA implementation, plugin, runtime change, engine rebuild, ONNX export, benchmark, or profiling was performed.

rules.2: At least one Phase 4-A.2 mapping row forms the HIGH chain kernel -> NVTX execution range -> ONNX node -> EngineInspector metadata -> TensorRT layer -> recognized Transformer operator.
rules.1: Phase 4-A.1 gives a HIGH TensorRT layer -> ONNX node -> operator chain, but no Phase 4-A.2 HIGH runtime row exists for that operator.
rules.0.5: Only MEDIUM evidence exists: the runtime chain reaches an existing ONNX node but the node does not identify a recognized Transformer operator.

rules.3: The candidate has at least one Phase 4-A.2 HIGH mapped runtime row and is explicitly named in the Phase 3-E mixed top-kernel operator_match set.
rules.2: Either the candidate has at least one Phase 4-A.2 mapped runtime row or it is explicitly named in the Phase 3-E mixed top-kernel operator_match set, but not both.
rules.0: Neither condition is supported by the committed evidence.

notes: GEMM layer type comes from Phase 4-A.1 and is not inferred from tactic name alone.
Tensor Core tactic evidence is the recorded tactic-family string; it is not used to infer operator identity.
Direct NCU evidence is credited only when Phase 3-E maps the same kernel to the candidate or its explicitly recorded operator_match set.
Dynamic shape receives no static-decode-shape point.

score_definitions.total_score: Sum of the three ordinal scores. Ties are not subdivided unless report text explicitly names a tie-breaking evidence field.

interpretation_limits: Phase 4-A.2 total_time_ns is all-trace NVTX-to-kernel summary time, not the Phase 3-C/3-E steady-state aggregate and must not be used as a steady-state performance share.
The Phase 3-E h16816 top-kernel time is shared by gate_proj and up_proj in the recorded operator_match set and cannot be split between them.

The single fused q/k/v runtime range contributes 1.480960 ms of all-trace time to each of q_proj, k_proj, and v_proj in candidate views; the same wall-clock time must not be triple-counted as workload time.
Tactic or kernel names were not used to infer an operator identity.
Ranking identifies a research target, not a proven optimization or predicted speedup.
